dissents.reason: Its 26-week channel falls 43% a year and it sits 2.4 widths above that line with the weekly MACD line still below zero, so this is a rally near the top of a steep downtrend rather than a pullback in an uptrend, and my channel reading points to a fall back toward the line rather than further gains.

At 43.6x trailing earnings with EPS down 0.9%, CAT is by far the most expensive name in the book (the next is JNJ at 24.3x): a cyclical machinery maker priced like a growth stock while its earnings shrink, which leaves no margin of safety.
